name: Dirt Bike
description: Any motorcycle designed primarily for off-road use, which DC bars from all public property.

restrictions.rule: Any motorcycle designed primarily for off-road use
May not be ridden, parked, stood or stopped on any public property in DC, except while being loaded to leave for another jurisdiction or private property, so it is ridden only on private property
Riding one on public property is punishable by a fine and up to 30 days in jail; a second conviction suspends the rider's license for a year, and the dirt bike may be forfeited
